properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1 is collision-broken; ships as an available primitive via crypto-js 3.3.0 alongside MD5. Presence recorded; no app call site found in this scan.

properties.name: pqs:context

The app exercises this curve live: SIWE login verification in integrations/siwe/api/verify.ts and wallet signing orchestrated by integrations/siwe/actions/siwe-message.ts. The curve is fixed by the Ethereum protocol — replaceable only by the chain, not in this app; PQ migration for the app's own signing flows w

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/poly1305 1.0.1 and @stablelib/chacha20poly1305 1.0.1 pinned in the root pnpm-lock.yaml, transitive deps of the web3 SDK stack. Poly1305 is a one-time MAC (symmetric) — Grover-only impact, no PQ urgency. No direct @stablelib import in application source; packages ship in the installed build.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: evp_bytestokey 1.0.3 — the legacy single-round MD5 KDF emulating OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey — pinned transitively in pnpm-lock.yaml. No app call site; ships in the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The Lit Protocol integration is live in app code: integrations/lit-protocol/client.ts instantiates LitNodeClient and hooks/use-lit-client.ts runs the full encrypt/wrap/unwrap/decrypt flow. The threshold-ECDSA machinery ships with it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 shipped to the build via the @stablelib stack (transitive, Ethereum/Lit ecosystem). Quantum-unsafe (Shor); ML-KEM-768 is the replacement where the protocol allows it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/curves 1.1.0 pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml. This is the EC library beneath viem (a direct app dependency) and also supplies the secp256k1 ECDSA the app's SIWE login ultimately reaches; the Ed25519 surface itself has no app call site. Shipped in the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/ed25519 1.0.3 pinned transitively in pnpm-lock.yaml. No app call site; ships in the build. Ed25519 is Shor-broken but a deadline risk (signatures), not harvestable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: X25519 available via libsodium-wrappers 0.7.11 pinned transitively in pnpm-lock.yaml (@lit-protocol stack). No app call site for X25519; ships in the build. X25519 key agreement is Shor-broken if used.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: NIST P-256 implementations shipped as part of the noble crypto stack (companion of @noble/hashes and @noble/curves used by viem/wagmi). Available to the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: ECDH available via elliptic 6.5.4 pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml — the classic EC library of the ethers-v5 web3 stack, which also carries the secp256k1 ECDSA used for Ethereum signatures. No app ECDH call site; ships in the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 is the Ethereum hashing standard: viem/ethers use it for transaction and EIP-191 message hashing, which feeds the app's live SIWE verification (integrations/siwe/api/verify.ts). Quantum-resistant in the Grover sense (2^128 preimage); CNSA 2.0 prefers 384-bit digests for new work.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 ships with the web3 stack (@ethersproject uses it for BIP39 mnemonic→seed derivation). No app call site found in this scan; when a caller uses it, the iteration count decides strength — OWASP minimum 600k iterations for PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HKDF ships via the stablelib and futoin packages in the Lit/Ethereum dependency tree; iron-session v6 (the app's session layer) also derives its AES-256-GCM cookie key via HKDF-SHA256 internally. Quantum-safe KDF ( HMAC-based ); no parameters to flag here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt-js 3.0.1 pinned transitively in pnpm-lock.yaml via ethers 5.6.9 — scrypt is the KDF for Ethereum keystore (encrypted private-key JSON) files. No app call site; ships in the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: AES available via crypto-js 3.3.0 — the 2015-era crypto-js line whose default key derivation is EVP_BytesToKey (single-round MD5) — pinned transitively in pnpm-lock.yaml. No app call site; ships in the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 as shipped via @noble/hashes (the hashing layer under viem/@noble/curves). Quantum-safe digest; part of the app's direct web3 dependency stack.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE3 as shipped via @noble/hashes@1.2.0. Quantum-safe extendable-output hash; available to the build via the noble crypto stack.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Same logical asset as ALG-052c24b2: Keccak/SHA-3 available to the build via another noble package. Keccak-256 is the Ethereum hashing standard (used by ethers for tx/message hashes).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: Argon2id available via libsodium-wrappers 0.7.11 pinned transitively in pnpm-lock.yaml (@lit-protocol stack). No app call site; ships in the build. Argon2id is the recommended password KDF — presence is good posture, not a risk.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/chacha20poly1305 1.0.1 pinned transitively in pnpm-lock.yaml (web3 SDK stack). Modern AEAD, symmetric so PQ-posture is fine (Grover-only). No app call site; ships in the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (libsodium crypto_secretbox) available via libsodium-wrappers 0.7.11 pinned transitively in pnpm-lock.yaml. Symmetric AE — PQ-posture fine. No app call site; ships in the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: XChaCha20-Poly1305 provided by libsodium-wrappers 0.7.11 (LIB-29efa58e), a dependency of the app's direct @lit-protocol/lit-node-client — the AEAD is available to the shipped Lit stack. Quantum-safe symmetric AE.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto-infrastructure dependency: @azure/keyvault-secrets client entries pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml, pulled transitively by the @lit-protocol/lit-node-client SDK (Lit's own Azure integrations). Azure Key Vault is a cloud KMS/secrets store; which algorithms it enforces is decided by the Azure service and the tenant's key policies, not this repo — observable here, replaceable only by the vendor. No Azure usage anywhere in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
